title: Named run configs in the runners files: one epic on GLM, another on claude
description: Operator, 2026-10-06: 'i might want multiple possible cloud configs in the same repo, so i might run one epic on glm and another on claude' — 'maybe easiest with multiple named configs in config files'. Design: the runners files (.tick/runners.toml / runners.local.toml / runners.cloud.toml) may declare named configs, e.g. [configs.glm] and [configs.claude], each a complete routing (roles, tiers, [tier_policy], concurrency caps such as claude-sub 1–2, fallbacks), with `default = "glm"` naming the one used when nothing selects. Selection: `ticfac run <epic> [--cloud] --config claude` > the epic's own field/label (e.g. config: claude, set when the epic is designed) > the default. The chosen config is recorded in the run record and shown in status/watch/the epic PR; escalation and cost are reported per config so configs can be compared on real epics. doctor and the run-start routing preflight resolve every named config and refuse one that cannot route (incl. a claude config with no subscription token configured). Keep the schema in references/runners-config.schema.json in sync (ticks repo) and validate. Builds on jvj's claude-sub rung design.
